title: swetest: main computation loop + body dispatch + header
description:
Wire up the main computation loop: date parsing, step iteration, body dispatch, header output, and basic position output using the default format.

**Date parsing** (C swetest lines 1369-1442):
- Calendar input: `1.1.2000` (day.month.year, European style)
- JD input: `j2451545.5`
- Julian/Gregorian auto-detection (pre-15 Oct 1582 = Julian)
- Time input from `-t` flag, combined with date
- UTC path via `swe_utc_to_jd` when `-utc` is set
- UT path: `tjd = julday(y,m,d,0) + thour/24`

**Step iteration** (C swetest lines 1449-1478):
- `-n` count, `-s` step with suffixes: plain (days), `y` (years), `mo` (months), `m` (minutes), `s` (seconds)
- Year/month stepping via `julday(year_start + (istep-1)*tstep, ...)` 
- Gregorian/Julian auto-switch per step

**Body dispatch**:
- Map `-p` selection string to body list using `letter_to_ipl` equivalent
- Expansion of list letters: `d` → `0123456789mtABCcg`, `p` → d + `DEFGHI`, `h` → `JKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZw`, `a` → p + h
- Special body handling: `s` → asteroid from `-xs`, `f` → fixstar from `-xf`, `v` → planet moon from `-xv`, `z` → fictitious from `-xz`
- Pseudo-bodies: `e` (label line), `q` (delta-T), `y` (time equation), `x` (sidereal time), `b` (ayanamsha), `n`/`o` (ecl/nut)

**Header output** (C swetest lines 1487-1579):
- Date line: `date (dmy) 1.1.2000 greg.  0:00:00 TT    version X.Y.Z`
- UT/TT/delta-T lines
- Epsilon (true/mean) and nutation
- Ayanamsha (when sidereal)
- Geographic position (when set)
- House system name (when `-house`)

**Basic output**: For each body, call `eph.calc()` or `eph.calc_ut()` and print the body name + `data[0..6]` in a simple columnar format. The format-sequence engine (task 147) replaces this placeholder.

**Key Rust API calls**:
- `Ephemeris::calc(jd_tt, body, flags)` / `calc_ut(jd_ut, body, flags)`
- `Ephemeris::fixstar2(jd_tt, star, flags)` / `fixstar2_ut`
- `date::julday`, `date::revjul`, `date::utc_to_jd`
- `deltat::calc_deltat`
- `Ephemeris::get_ayanamsa_ex`
- `sidereal_time::sidereal_time`
- `Ephemeris::get_planet_name`

acceptance_criteria.text: swetest -b1.1.2000 -emos -p0123456789 prints Sun through Pluto positions
swetest -b1.1.2000 -pd prints the default body set (Sun-Pluto + nodes + Lilith + Chiron)

implementation_plan: compute.rs: resolve_start_jd → step_jd loop → print_header (step 1) → compute_body per BodySpec. main.rs thin wrapper: parse_args → to_ephemeris_config → Ephemeris::new → compute::run. Placeholder columnar output (name + data[0..5]).
execution_record: Implemented as planned. New compute.rs module (~500 lines) with: resolve_start_jd (calendar/JD date parsing, UT/ET/LMT path dispatch), step_jd (5 step-unit types), print_header (date/UT/TT/deltaT/epsilon/nutation/ayanamsa/geopos/houses), compute_body (all 11 BodySpec variants dispatching to eph.calc/fixstar2/time_equ/sidereal_time/get_ayanamsa_ex/calc_deltat). Fixed a date-display bug where ET-mode header showed the UT-derived date (Dec 31 instead of Jan 1) by using the TT JD for revjul in ET mode. Fixed format_time to handle negative hours via wrapping to [0,24). All 8 acceptance criteria verified in-session. Output uses a simple fixed-column format as placeholder for task 147 (format-sequence engine).
